description: The folding profile query_key uses per platform (ADR-0044; Q10). exact: NFC and lower case only; folded: also tashkeel and tatweel removed and the Arabic letter variants merged. Every platform starts at exact; a platform moves to folded only when its probe records that its search treats those variants as the same, through /contract-change, since the keys change (open items O-1 to O-9).
